powerArchitecture.path: VBUS -> D1 -> VSYS -> U2 -> 3V3 -> U1 core buck/L1/C2 -> 1V1
powerArchitecture.combinedRailRangeBasis: Intersection of RP2350 USB/analog minimum 3.135 V and W25Q32RV maximum 3.6 V; nominal 3.3 V alone does not prove this range under all loads/transients.
powerArchitecture.externalCurrentAdvice: Pico recommends less than 300 mA, dependent on VSYS and onboard load; not a guaranteed rating here.
powerArchitecture.enable: Header37 pulls to VSYS through R9; ground to disable; not a 3.3 V GPIO.
powerArchitecture.adcReference: 3V3 -> R16 200 ohm -> ADC_VREF/header35 -> R17 1 ohm -> ADC_AVDD44; C17=4.7 uF schematic value, not 2.2 uF prose.
powerArchitecture.analogGround: Header33 AGND is GND electrically, with a quiet ADC return/placement region.
powerArchitecture.combinedSupplies: D1 blocks VSYS-to-VBUS only; simultaneous USB and external VSYS require external blocking/power-path circuitry. A directly attached raw cell can be charged through D1.
powerArchitecture.external3v3Injection: Not supported by default; arbitrary regulator backfeed/parallel outputs are unreviewed.

openDecisions.detail: Exact MPNs, effective capacitance, voltage/power/current, ESR/ESL, inductor rolloff and LED behavior require source-backed selection.
Candidate pin maps are not admitted native footprints. Exact flash XH and center-pad convention, buttons, crystal, headers and passives remain to bind.
Winbond Rev E marks XH special order. Do not substitute a stock SOIC/WSON or different flash silently.

Winbond requires CS to track VCC during power-up/down. Deliberately holding BOOT low at cold power-up conflicts with that literal condition; Pico uses this strap. Stable-powered BOOT + RUN avoids deliberate cold-start loading. This integration condition remains unresolved. Pullup does not override held button. Minimum tVSL=20 us; write-related tPUW=5 ms are future boot integration constraints, not implemented firmware.

Source advertisement/enumeration, input current, hot-plug/inrush, total capacitance, CC protection and ESD clamp compatibility remain unqualified. Rd does not implement PD or grant 3 A. ST leakage is specified at 5.25 V; do not extend that guarantee to 5.5 V.
External current depends on VSYS and onboard load. Approximately 350 mA total near 1.8 V is only a Richtek typical graph estimate. JEDEC four-layer thermal data does not qualify this board.
Layer count, thickness, dielectric/copper data, USB body/launch/branch geometry, power loops, ground vias, EP connections and connector fit remain engineering decisions.
Forty functions, 2.54 mm contact pitch and 17.78 mm row spacing are the target. Castellations, mounting holes, exact header lands, SWD handling and assembly fit remain open.
